method: Read-only. Bounded JSON receipt reads (4 MiB cap), SHA256 of small control files, /proc PID check and a Win32_Process census. No arrays loaded, no process started or signalled, no file under converted_datasets/ modified.

scope.definition: Every top-level directory of converted_datasets/reconversion_v2 is a retained job record, because each was written by a plan, launcher, pilot, audit, review or staging step. Each gets a row unless it is the execution record of a queue job (folded into that row). Every job in a current or retired queue plan, or in a plan-less queue status, also gets a row. Completeness is checked against an independent directory and plan-file enumeration.
scope.beyond_snapshots: Includes the 20 Oct generation (four fixed-data queues, the corrected queue and three dispatchers), all detours, native MATLAB pilots, subset auditors, readbacks, reviews, proposals, prepared plans and drafts absent from the 39/49 snapshots, and jobs listed only in retired queue plan versions.
scope.revision: 2026-10-27 r2: widened after independent verification (docs/maintainers/handoffs/PM-02-verify.json) found about 35 directories with status or plan records that had no row.

disposition_definitions.completed_unreviewed: Terminal success receipt, rehashed now. Evidence for the owner task only; not scientific approval.
disposition_definitions.superseded: A named later job or result replaces it; the chain ends in another disposition.
disposition_definitions.needs_fresh_reviewed_plan: Still in scope. The owner task writes a new reviewed plan for the guarded single-job launcher; the old definition is never resumed.
disposition_definitions.quarantined_known_bad: Recipe known to be wrong; never rerun as defined. The owner task must settle the correction first.
disposition_definitions.obsolete: No longer needed or no longer reproducible; closed by PM-02.

historical_controller_release.meaning: Historical fact retained: the detour released the GT21 controller on 21 Oct. That controller is gone; nothing is resumed now.

linux.note: Every recorded PID belongs to the previous boot. A PID number present now is an unrelated reuse unless its command line names a job.

unresolved: gt25_streaming_transfer_pilot_v2 (28 observations) predates the GT25 ankle-sign stop and its independent source audit never ran; GT25-P01 must decide whether the sign error applies before using it.
gt21_metadata_corrected_20261021 failed at AB06 treadmill_07_01; its cause was not investigated because the force-corrected batch replaced it.
Owner mappings follow directory names, queue plans and watcher references; the owner task re-reads its rows before writing a plan.
limitations: Receipts and hashes only; no scientific output was reread. completed_unreviewed is not approval.
Process absence is a point-in-time check; any launch must repeat it.
Plans larger than 4 MiB are recorded by size, not hashed.
